scope: a-d-b flash path, exercised on real hardware for the first time

flashes.note: shared-image variant: no rover image exists upstream (404); rubyfish is 200

claims_confirmed: image names are read from the release's own SHA512SUMS, not hardcoded
SHA512 verification runs and passes before flashing
shared-image variants flash their base image, via the port's hostname-derived codename
flashing works in both directions, older and newer

independent_corroboration.source: fleet registry change-log, not informed by the flasher

defects.detail: a-d-b reports flash progress via log.info; a script that does not configure the root logger sees no output and the flash appears stalled

corrections.claim: the flash path does not map a shared-image variant to its base image
corrections.why: inferred from _download_nightly(codename) being verbatim without checking callers; both flash paths resolve via find_codename_for_loc_port(), which returns the hostname-derived name

facts_established: benchymark is Qt6-only and cannot run on 2.0 or 2.1, so it cannot measure a pre-Qt6 build
